title: Unclassified assignment literal: benign encoded value controls
summary: 2 inputs holding benign encoded or hashed values of the same general shape.
rationale: Hashes, checksums and encoded text share alphabets and lengths with credentials. Reporting them is a false alarm that grows with repository size.

expectation.rationale: Relabelled by docs/decisions/2026-09-29-relabel-provider-named-near-miss-controls-under-948.md: was must-not-flag/T2 on daytona-api-key (a malformed-by-construction near miss, expected silence); is policy/T3 on generic-token with the value after DAYTONA_API_KEY= as the secret span, expected action redact. Random or secret-shaped material under the provider's own credential variable is a credential under the amended project policy (redact-secret#948, amendment of decision-redact-provider-named-credential-assignments, 2026-09-29): generic-token claims it at the generic floors (redact at 16 bytes and entropy 3.0, else warn). No daytona-api-key provider-format claim is made.

externalRefs.note: Legacy benchmark issue the suite slice was written for.
